# Vivek Gawande

Senior Software Engineer specializing in C# / .NET full-stack web development,
based in Navi Mumbai, India. 7 years building enterprise applications with
.NET and modern web technologies — C# .NET Core, Entity Framework Core,
SQL Server, Oracle, Vue, and Angular.
